notes.title: Demolish & Build 3 Prologue - Release Date Trailer
notes.notes:
🏗️The site is ready, and the deal is set on both ends.

Turn up the radio and mood for the job as heavy equipment is coming to do the heavy lifting. Tools and materials provided, bring your safety gloves and shoes and mark the day.

Demolish & Build 3 Prologue is set to start construction works on 
March 1st, 2024.

🥾⛑️🦺🧤🎧⚠️👷✅Ok, you are ready to go.
[previewyoutube=x5cV7m8rwSc;full]https://youtu.be/x5cV7m8rwSc[/previewyoutube]
Demolish & Build 3: Prologue will include the first few missions of the full game and features:

🚧 Large excavator.
🚧 Skid steer.
🚧 Attachments
🚧 Physics-based track mechanics,
🚧 Vehicle controls based on real machines.
🚧 Full controller support,
🚧 Fully destructible objects and structures
🚧 Third-person and first-person camera modes,

A Basic Manual Training course for future foremen can be accessed on the main website in the form of a playable demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1203670/Demolish__Build_3/

Basic excavator training is also provided: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2021130/Demolish__Build_3_Excavator_Playground/

Stay tuned for details of the contract. Stay cautious on the job site!

Dear Foremen,

Today is the day we lurk out of production to showcase what we were building in the last couple of months. Bringing this game together is a real challenge, but we are quite proud of what we have achieved so far and more than optimistic about what is to come.

In the upcoming weeks, we will share a little bit more of gamepad gameplay with vehicle controls and some other goodies.

We hope you'll enjoy it.

Yours,
Demolish & Build 3 Team.

notes.title: Update demo - full customization for controllers/joysticks/steering wheels
notes.notes:
Demolishers!

Many of you have asked for the addition of full optimization for controllers. Especially for you, we have prepared an update related to these changes. As of now, you can assign any function to a button or axis in our demo - Demolish & Build 3: Excavator Playground.

We took great care to create a system that is both flexible and easy to use. With it you can use any number and any type of controllers. Also, we did our best to allow you to assign whatever button or axis to every important function. In the future we will also add options to calibrate and fine-tune your axes to give you the best experience you can have.


In the instructions below, we show you how to setup custom controls.

⦁	Select your controller here: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/827a46ffeaf897d30902fb68cc6c8d072d11195e.png

⦁	This button allows you to remove the current assignment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/a50b8412458f37ac25ea56f4e02c87bd8ef6cb33.png

⦁	To assign a button select a function…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/5ba6272b98a2fd4d1789b7e1c2165b6609b4e260.png

… and press the chosen button. Only buttons from the selected controller will be pooled. You can also assign an axis as a button (for ex. LT/RT on a controller).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/f7fc7e76c868e7680b4cdd6e7079eeb28060a51e.png

⦁	To assign an axis, first select chosen function from the list

⦁	There are 4 modes available: Axis, Buttons, Axis with a modifier, Buttons with a modifier

⦁	Axis/Buttons
To assign simply select the function and use chosen axis or button

⦁	Axis/Buttons with Modifier
Axis/Buttons with Modifier is a special function that allows you to use the same controller axis for multiple functions. In practice, the Modifier works like a Shift Key – pressing it will override the default function and use this one instead.

EXAMPLE:

Let’s use this method to setup the Xbox 360 controller to the SAE pattern instead of the default ISO. 
For the sake of this presentation, we’ll use an empty layout but you can just as easily modify an existing one.

⦁	Start by assigning button functions: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/c11052706f1d6ba05d8635245c0e112de53ccd65.png

⦁	Assign the RT/RB to the right track
⦁	Select right track forward

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/b2b80658989785a47da1ac5f40cef661105ee6e7.png

⦁	Select no binding and press RT to assign it 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/7855999a33ed2417cd88f55c3dc13429ffedb58c.png

⦁	Return to the list

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/35e801d658684a4ec5f4bfa22c670165b2fb5bbe.png

⦁	Select the right track backward 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/ab63b561cab02788323fd33d39aa21c7169d5b73.png

⦁	Choose BUTTONS mode

⦁	Select no binding next to RIGHT TRACK BACKWARD + and assign RB

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/8424eb2ee651fef8e4d564d3014202cf064c868c.png

⦁	Repeat the same for the left track

⦁	Select rotate cabin (left, right), axis mode, and assign left stick X (horizontal) axis.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/01bc472c24f90a05e9f7283fba39eb84bb9fb11a.png

⦁	Select rotate boom (up, down), axis mode, and assign left stick Y (vertical) axis.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/67886d36c134266a61b68da0822f113d14ffb970.png

⦁	Now, let’s move on to the right stick. Select extend attachment, axis mode, and assign right stick X axis. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/3369f479be2945866fca24bdbfa9d2ba4f39f214.png

⦁	Select rotate arm (up, down), axis mode, and assign right stick Y axis.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/9c178c0a8dc61d235cd9693a500332afb097e570.png

⦁	We also need to rotate the shears

⦁	Select rotate attachment horizontally

⦁	Change mode to BUTTONS

⦁	Assign D-Pad left/right to the appropriate functions

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/627270aaadc50d6e27e3a8c78c26c53aebd4bae2.png

⦁	That leaves us with camera controls. Since we’ve already assigned all controller axes we’ll use the modifier.

⦁	Select rotate camera

⦁	Choose AXIS WITH MODIFIER mode

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/dc7cf061c25847d3d5864aa93f8086bd25d55dae.png

⦁	First assign the left stick button to the MODIFIER

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/9432e6e77ac5691775b3e5ad36d1fd618715e2e0.png

⦁	Now let’s assign the right stick axes to both functions
This means that when we press the right stick button the left stick will control the camera instead of the excavator’s left joystick.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/85e35570d361f55ffc4d12305ac6a0b65bbbf8a2.png

⦁	Repeat the same steps for camera zoom with the right stick button and left stick y.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/f937f0a623803e98f607ba263e92b3e3bfe610bb.png

That’s it. We’ve created working SAE controls for our controller from scratch.


Some additional rules/tips when creating custom control schemes:

⦁	A single axis can be assigned to only one function without modifiers.
⦁	You cannot use the same button for the modifier and a normal function.
⦁	On the other hand, a button can be used as a modifier for multiple functions.
⦁	You do not have to assign every function for a single controller.
⦁	If you want to assign a full axis to one of the tracks, best assign it to the left/right track forward functions.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1203670

If you have any suggestions, or ideas about the game, please write to us. Join our discord:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26225940/2e8a36948df3ac59a88c8b713340816a0c19bf76.png

Stay safe and happy demolition!
Demolish Games crew

notes.title: Demolish & Build 3: Excavator Playground Release!
notes.notes:
This day has come!

Demolish & Build 3: Excavator Playground - play the demo now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2021130

Watch the trailer here:

[previewyoutube=oC2o8nbJn9M;full][/previewyoutube]

Demolish & Build 3: Excavator Playground is a playable sneak peek at the driving and demolition physics from the upcoming Demolition & Build 3. In the game, you take control of a modern excavator and drive around a small test track or demolish structures.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/f3f8843d4c8c474cc685d4ba756adb13b38f18c8.jpg

Demolish & Build 3 will include brand new demolition and driving physics. This short tech demo allows you to try them out before the final release.

The full version of the game - Demolish & Build 3 is coming in 2023.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/4f5c69e21a993b6768d21cfed6e379ca121ce2c7.jpg

Some of the main features of Demolish & Build 3: Excavator Playground include:
 
 A large excavator equipped with demolition shears
 Vehicle controls based on real excavators
 Vehicle controls based on real excavators
 Physics-based track mechanics
 Full controller support
 Fully destructible objects
 A small test track
 Ramps
 Concrete structures that can be demolished
 Third-person and first-person camera modes
 And more…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/c27cb6d9cfdc3c68cc4b0ea8264dce899bb2b20d.jpg

Play the demo now and send us your feedback!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26225940/2e8a36948df3ac59a88c8b713340816a0c19bf76.png

Cheers!
Demolish Games Team

notes.title: New patch 14.03.2018
notes.notes:
Okay, some small fixes incoming:
-pickups now have correct center of mass and should no longer look strange while pressing brake
-you can now summon the hose back to hydrant by pressing on the hydrant
-in multiplayer characters no longer sprint in place after pressing esc or interacting with signs
-scraps car parts that require lift should automatically turn up when upside down
-small visual improvements
-small collider improvements

notes.title: 12.03.2018 TEST patch
notes.notes:
Hello there,
the new patch can be unstable, in case of problems with it, I will roll back to the last stable one.

Fix list:
-exit crash bug fixed
-explosives blocking accept contract button fixed
-stuttering should be fixed in most machines
-network code updated, possibly fixing some connection issues
-client excavator dropping load bug fixed
-other small fixes on maps
-maximum rank requirements lowered

notes.title: Early patch 11.03.2018 and NETWORK NOTICE
notes.notes:
Hello there, since we don't have lives and love working at weekends we made a new small patch. 
Jokes aside, here are the changes:
-different bulldozer sounds
-pickup truck is now louder
-fix in Dorfenberg mainentenance task trash bag
-toggle TPP camera (beta) - console command "tpp"
-chat no longer opens inventory after pressing "i"
-income raports no longer saves the game
-hose will not lock the player in place anymore
-some small fixes

We are aware of network problems of some players and are working hard with server provider to FIX them.
Cheers

notes.title: Release and state of game 10.03.2018
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
first of all thank you for support and kind words about the game.
It's been fun watching you play the game on twitch and youtube :)

We are gathering feedback and are already working on fixing bugs and tweaking gameplay.
The first patch will be released on monday, please be patient with us.

Again thank you all, looking at players having fun with our game is the best feeling ever.

Cheers,
Peter
